meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 按我的要求给选中的 NanoClaw 分组安装无密钥的 Tavily 搜索/提取工具:它会先问要装给哪些分组,然后安装 mcp-remote 桥、注册 tavily 服务、重启分组并验证;额度用尽时引导用 OneCLI 链接升级。
howto.when: 当用户要求安装无 API 密钥的 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取功能,或指定给某些 NanoClaw 分组添加这些工具时触发。

say.text: 装好后用 max_results 1 跑一次 Tavily 搜索测试
say.note: 它用 tavily_search 验证工具是否可用。

say.text: Tavily 额度用尽了,帮我配置付费升级
say.note: 它会给出 OneCLI 的预填链接并等你确认。

howto.what_en: When asked, it installs keyless Tavily Search and Extract for chosen NanoClaw groups by setting up the mcp-remote bridge, registering a tavily MCP server, restarting groups, and verifying the tools. If the keyless allowance runs out, it guides the user through a paid upgrade via a OneCLI link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key, or specifies NanoClaw groups that should get these tools.

say_en.text: Add keyless Tavily Search and Extract to group-a and group-b.
say_en.note: It checks, installs the bridge, and registers the tavily server.

say_en.text: Run a Tavily search with max_results 1 to test it.
say_en.note: It verifies the tool using tavily_search.

say_en.text: I hit the Tavily keyless limit; set up the paid upgrade.
say_en.note: It provides the prefilled OneCLI deeplink and waits for confirmation.
